title: Debtor open total sums raw remaining, which can exceed the opened amount while out-of-order changes converge

bugs.note: Changes to a debt are applied as commuting increments in any order (the comment on Apply says so). A reopen recorded before the settlement it undoes lifts remaining above the opened amount until the settlement lands. openTotal is presented as the amount a collector should take, so in that window it reports more than the debtor can owe; each debt should count at most its opened amount.
